reviews.t: but it's very nice and cute for my cosplay
reviews.x: It's brighter then I thought...meaning more of a red hue...but it's very nice and cute for my cosplay. If you unfold the tail it's pretty long and it can bend to any shape you put it. I wish the method of putting the tail on was different besides a ribbon but that's fine. The ears are like Bobby pin like things to clip onto the wig or your hair. Overall it's pretty nice

reviews.t: Pick up some better clips to hold the ears on; otherwise very nice!
reviews.x: Ears do not stay in at all with those clips. Kinda weird how high quality they are and yet they have the worst pins ever haha. I used some clear hair clamps to pin them in and that worked to keep them in one spot with my hair pulled back.  The tail is HUGE even at the smallest length. The fur itself is short but the tail body is very long and wide. Not very wolffish but makes a cute grey fox.  Overall great if you want a low-cost tail and ears that look more expensive. Not good for a werewolf co

reviews.t: Works great for what I purchased for
reviews.x: I got these for a photo shoot so they worked great for what I needed. I wore these for about 5 hours. The bobby pins on the ears didn’t hold very well in my thin hair so I had to reenforce with more pins. The tail is beautiful and very soft. I had very little shedding occur. I can’t say how well they would hold up on wear for something like a convention, but I’m sure with reenforcement on the ears and tail connection, these would work great

reviews.t: The tail is awesome and huge
reviews.x: The tail is awesome and huge. Ears are cute but a little difficult to keep in your hair. Delivery time was almost 2 wks longer than I was told.

reviews.t: Great quality and the length was
reviews.x: I got the smaller tail because it was eligible for Amazon Prime.  Great quality and the length was great

reviews.t: A bit too long and doesn't seem to be holding up well
reviews.x: My son loves it but it is not holding up well to regular wear. It looks frazzled and rather ugly after a month of occasional use. On the plus side the ribbons are surprisingly strong, I thought for sure they'd rip out of the tail but they haven't. He ties it around his waist through his belt loops and it stays pretty well. The ears are no good for boys, they are hair clips that slide in and then flop right over from the their own weight. Might work better in a girls hair if hair sprayed though?

As other reviews have mentioned, the clips are pretty terrible (they’re basically a long bobby pin and don’t offer a lot of support for the ears). But for the price and what you get, I can fix that myself. If you tried to buy ears and tails that are this nice on Etsy, you’d spend anywhere from $60-125 plus shipping (I checked lol). I got the light brown ones and as you can see, they are actually a dark orangish-red color. I was actually counting on that though as I wanted oranage but not a brigh
Very nice for the price! we did hot glue the ears to a head band and the worked out very nice. Paired with a japanese school girl outfit for ComiCon and had lots of compliments.

reviews.t: the tail is great, but the ears have to be attached to
reviews.x: the tail is great,but the ears have to be attached to something

The fur was nice quality and the tail itself was a good shape and size. It was more red-brown as some reviewers said, but that’s what I was looking for. The wire inside was very handy - it held a nice curve shape. The ribbon to tie around you was the perfect length for me (women’s size 10/12). I tied it around my bare waist and it was actually pretty comfortable. I rigged the tail upright (I was technically a squirrel character from a video game for Halloween) with some transparent thread sewn t

The tail has been great, the fur is nice. But the ears (I think someone else has mentioned this) don't stay up. I thought my wifes thick hair would took care of that but they still flop to the side. Hopefully I can fabricate something to make them stay up. Guess I'll have to pretend that shes just a floppy eared b***ch

reviews.t: Tail is great but with a ribbon to tie it on with ...
reviews.x: Tail is great but with a ribbon to tie it on with as a belt is not so good. Needs a clip or large safety pin to pin it on.  Ears are held on with a large bobby pin looking thing. Over all tail is great looking. Looks like a cat when sitting on the table.
Arrived quickly. The brown fur is a lot more copper than brown though! Keep that in mind. I bought it hoping it'd be like that. The items are good, but I honestly hate the ribbon and ear pins lol
Great Ears and tail. they look just like the picture!! worked great for my cosplay.

The quality of this ear and tail set is better than average for the money.  I didn't love them, though.  As other reviewers noted, the clips on the ears are basically useless, so plan to replace them unless you have baby-fine hair.  I also found that the tail did not want to  sit "right" when I tied it on.  Maybe it was the weight, the size of my backside or some combination of the two, but it just didn't look right on me, so I'll be returning the set.

My daughter loved this set. The ribbon used to tie the tail around your waist could be better. Ribbon started to unravel after trying it on. We replaced the ribbon with an elastic band and it worked beautifully. Ears clip on and we had no issues with keeping the ears in place. The quality of the item was great but maybe a little expensive

reviews.t: A few small problems, but nothing that can't be fixed.
reviews.x: It works alright, but would suggest that you put the strap around the back of the tail, because if you have it curled upwards, it falls to the side when you move. Otherwise, great product! Going to use it for a Halloween costume.

The tail was a lot bigger than I expected but easy to put on the ears on the other hand were a little difficult because they come with clips so I put him when I headband but other than that the costume is perfect

reviews.t: Great tail, ears could use some work
reviews.x: I used these for my Halloween costume this year. The tail worked great, but the ears don't stay very well, since the bobby pins don't have any grooves. I'll probably glue them to a small headband for future use.

Scaming people... this is worth at least 11 or 10 dollars not 44 it wasn't even free shipping like it said. I'm so upset... very poor quality the ear clips are awkward the tail is stiff. Money wasted for sure :(
Decent quality for the price. The tail holds it's shape well. The boppy pins are not great (thick/hard to slide/rips your hair painfully) on the ears, but you could just use your own through them.
Ears and tail were better than expected. I did not experience the fur falling out. They held up really well on a drunken Halloween evening! I kept the ears in place with extra bobby pins
Cute and perfect fox stuff. Everything was super soft. I put new clips on because it needed 2 to keep the ears more open. MY dog ate them after I wore them but, my fault.. lol
I was looking for a cruelty free tail and ears that looked like the real stuff and this fit the balled "furfictly" 😂 great craftsmanship for a good price thank you so much ❤️
Super soft tail and ears. Looked great for my costume! The ears were easy to put on and stayed all day. The only issue I had was the tie for the tail was a bit small for me.

claims.text: The tail is widely praised as great, soft, and large, with many noting its impressive size and quality fur.
The ear clips/bobby pins are a common complaint, with many reviewers saying they don't hold well and recommending replacement or reinforcement.
Several reviewers note the color is more red/copper than expected brown.
The ribbon attachment method for the tail is disliked by some reviewers.
Some reviewers report durability issues, with the product looking frazzled after a month of use.
